answer: Scarce Action Budget: each agent identity gets a fixed daily quota of signed actions, replenished only by a verifiable work receipt whose issuer co-signs under liability. Above the dune of free quota, every extra action requires consuming a receipt the issuer can't reuse, so clones drain their sponsors' scarce supply. Reaching the summit of full privileges demands a costly public audit trail. At the zenith of trust, identity splits trigger quota decay, making each clone strictly negative-EV for its operator.
